chapter: Small groups, Europe and Kansas City memories (repeated passages)
title: Guest dates in Copenhagen and a look at the map of Denmark
summary: He played in Copenhagen as a guest of a bandleader who toured the Danish islands, and they trace the route through Aarhus and Aalborg on a map.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Copenhagen and played with Andres(?) Meyer, as a guest, you know...
I guess he took over the radio band.

Well, at the time he wasn't... He was just traveling around the islands, you know -- the different islands. I went way up to Aarhus(X), or whatever the name of that place is, way up there, the northern port of... Isn't the name Aarhus(X) or something like that...
There's a Denmark map up there.
Yeah, it's Aarhus probably. It's a fairly big city. It's like the second largest in Denmark.
[FINDS MAP] Denmark is in here somewhere. Well, this is...
Yes, this is Aarhus. Well, Copenhagen is here...
And we went way up over through here ...(?)...
That's it, we went to Aardvar(X). And then we came back through down around in here somewhere. [ETC.]
See, we came down into this town here; came down in there.
It's a nice country, you know...
It's nice to have that little nest egg.
Because you never know when you're going need something with (?) somebody to vouch for you.
